### What Wondrous Love IS This?
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/what-wondrous-love-is-this/
Passage: Psalm 136:1-3
Points:
- God's enduring, steadfast love displayed in Christ is the most anchoring and life-giving reality for believers.
- Present suffering, sickness, and social division are only temporary and will eventually be overcome by God's eternal kingdom.
- Believers' flaws, selfishness, and limited understanding have an expiration date when they will finally be made like Jesus.
- The eternal day will completely eradicate injustice, sin, and strife, filling all creation with Christ's glory.
